text: TFT Set 14: Cyber City Update TFT 14 Core Changes, Hacking System - Hacking can happen anytime and in any round!If the Encounter is hacked, you will get a hacked champion card, and if the Common Pick round is hacked, your champion may turn into anvils. Also, if the Creep round is hacked, you will get a unstable item or a dragon egg that turns into a new crafted item every Champion round. Hacked Augment - When an augmentation round is hacked, the augments on the left will change to match the theme. Some augments that disappeared in previous seasons will appear, giving a refresh and additional gold.1 or 2 Augment - Another round of augmentation hacks will have you choose between one augmentation of a higher level and two augmentations of a lower level.
